positions.title: Student Intern - Technical I
positions.description: Professional development as well as technical training through mentors developing for projects they're currently working on. Working/researching/developing with Docker, an open platform for distributed applications, for cloud based technologies. Mostly spinning up lightweight web services and easily moving them from server to server. As ATT moves to a cloud base infrastructure this will help the early phases of transition. Also currently the developer for the WSR tool used by the interns to keep a record of weekly achievements and project progress as well as an overview for supervisors. I've also grown my professional development as I've participated in Aspire Mentoring, where we mentor high school students, as well as toast masters to improve my presentation skills.

positions.title: Associate Developer
positions.description: Associate Programmer under the NASA contract FDOC(Facilities Development and Operations Contract). Collaborate with a group to develop web based tools and applications to optimize processes. Modified a tool that helps designers categorize and track design progress for better UI and efficiency. Built a parser tool using MVC design to take in large excel sheets, upwards of 1,000,000 entries of CPU usage data, parse them, and export them to a reporting service in which we display a visual representation of the CPU statistics for user analysis in just a few minutes. This will save the company hours in interpreting CPU usage statistics to quickly determine possible misbehaving processes. I have presented the application to the stakeholders and it's moving along into production.

company.name: The University of Texas at El Paso

positions.title: Lead Programmer/Web Developer
positions.description: Developing, managing and maintaining web based media for the college of engineering. The title includes creating websites, functionality for the sites, maintaining databases,  content for the sites, updating old sites to mobile friendly, maintaining media outlets such as the college’s youtube, flickr and facebook pages. Both front end and back end skills were learned. Have created sites for the college, departments, and individual organizations such as cids.utep.edu .

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description: Apprenticed with Dr. Olac Fuentes to develop a fly tracking system for the biology department. Learned and applied object detection & object tracking principles. Able to track up to 30 flies in a 3D environment using a single low resolution camera with about 90% accuracy. Awarded 3rd place at a COURI symposium for my work.

positions.title: Student/Researcher
positions.description: Worked towards the groups focus on bettering human-computer interactions by building more dynamic agents through the research of human speech and body language. Developed scripts for audio analysis, was ran through a corpus of around 4000 audio files
